Hi Lydia —

Welcome — excited to get BrightWave live. Short answers up front, then a compact playbook below.

Summary: portal preferred for onboarding, email fallback allowed during transition. We support multi-PO invoices but require a deterministic PO column for automatic matching. You should expect an ACK token (we'll echo a brief header) for every successful submission.

Key details:
- Portal vs email: Portal (https://vendor.redwood.ai) gives immediate ACKs, richer metadata capture, and reduces manual work. Email (ap-invoices@redwood.ai) is supported as a fallback; subject line must include your vendor ID and primary PO (see example below).
- Multi-PO invoices: Allowed. Provide a row-level PO column (PO_NUMBER) for each line; if you submit a single PDF that contains multiple POs, include a companion CSV mapping file with filename convention: INVOICEID_map.csv.
- Required fields for automated PO stamping/matching: INVOICE_ID, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), SUPPLIER_NAME, PO_NUMBER, LINE_DESCRIPTION, LINE_QTY, LINE_UNIT_PRICE, LINE_TOTAL. Optional but useful: TAX_AMOUNT, SHIP_TO_LOCATION, COST_CENTER.
- File types: Preferred: CSV or XLSX for line-level ingestion + optional PDF for human-readable invoice. If only PDF available, raise a ticket and we'll queue OCR (delays possible).
- ACK token: On successful ingest you'll get a short ACK in the response header: X-RW-ACK: rw-ACK-<8 char>. Keep the attached ack-token-example.txt for formatting guidance.

Compact submission examples (subject / filename conventions):
- Portal: upload invoice_789_20250401.csv + invoice_789_20250401.pdf (portal provides ACK and ledger id)
- Email fallback: To ap-invoices@redwood.ai, Subject: \"VendorID: BRW-452 | Invoice: 789 | PO: PO-1122,PO-1123\"; Attachments: invoice_789.pdf, invoice_789_map.csv

Next steps:
1) Use the attached template (redwood_invoice_template_v1.xlsx) to map your sample CSV and resend so we can sanity-check mapping.
2) If portal roll-in is blocked on your side, send 2 sample invoices via email and we'll validate mapping and return an ACK token for each.

I'll loop Vanessa (OPS) and Kim (AP) — they'll take care of the mapping/validation queue.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the clear checklist; that's helpful. A couple follow-ups from our AP team:

1) Multiple POs per line vs multiple lines: We typically consolidate multiple POs into grouped line items (one line per service with a comma-separated PO field). Does your ingestion support comma-separated PO lists per line or do you require one PO per line?
2) ACK timing: If we post to portal, how soon do we receive the X-RW-ACK header? Immediate (within seconds) or batched (minutes)?
3) Late-fee/discount fields: Do you accept custom header fields (e.g., NET_TERMS, DISCOUNT_PERCENT) so our ERP can populate payment terms?

We will try the portal next week but wanted to validate these before we build the mapping export.

Cheers,
Lydia

Hi Lydia —

Great questions — answers below. I'll keep this short so your engineers can map appropriately.

1) PO mapping: Our ingestion requires one PO value per line for strict auto-matching. Comma-separated lists in a single PO field are not supported by the auto-matcher; if you must send aggregated lines, please include a companion map CSV (INVOICEID_map.csv) that enumerates PO -> line ranges. We can accept grouped lines for human-processing but those will fall to manual matching and delay payment.

2) ACK timing: Portal ACKs are immediate (sub-second to a few seconds) for successful schema validation. If the ingest triggers an async validation (e.g., OCR for PDF-only), the ACK will contain status: \"queued\" and we'll send a follow-up webhook/update within minutes. Email submissions will typically ACK within 1–10 minutes depending on queue.

3) Custom header fields: Yes — we accept NET_TERMS and DISCOUNT_PERCENT in header metadata; include them in the portal form or in the email body as a short metadata block (key:value). Ensure date formats and numeric fields match the template.

Validation task: Please re-export one of your sample invoices using the attached template and upload to the portal or resend by email with the subject convention from my earlier note. We'll validate and return a real X-RW-ACK token you can use for reconciliation testing.

I'll assign Vanessa to run the mapping check and Kim to confirm PO stamping rules on our ledger side. If you want, we can schedule a 20-min screen share on Monday to walk through your ERP export.

Thanks,
Diego
